text: Sea's Digital Financial Services (Monee) revenue grew 60.1%, from US$2.4 billion in 2024 to US$3.8 billion in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.100]. This was mainly driven by growth in the credit business, as lending activities expanded and loans receivable nearly doubled—from US$4.2 billion at end-2024 to US$8.0 billion at end-2025. That growth in loans receivable was itself fueled by several factors: growth of the Shopee e-commerce platform, deepening penetration of consumer lending on the platform, and expansion of credit offerings beyond the e-commerce platform. By year-end 2025, approximately 95% of loans receivable were attributable to consumer and SME loans [Sea, FY2025, p.100].
